Capped at Tier 2 due to engineered meatball filler (soy flour) and natural flavorings, i.e. a functional/hybrid product rather than a pure whole-food matrix.

notes: Contains soy and milk allergens. Soy flour is a binder, not a seed oil or isolate; not disqualifying under the rules.
